title: TopologyArtifactOverlayCompileRequest
description: Service-to-service request for compiling a bounded topology follow-up into overlay operations that agent-core can persist and relay for artifact or workbench flows.

artifact.description: Validated topology base binding that anchors compilation to the same base view the UI rendered. The field keeps its historical name even when the caller is operating on a workbench session instead of an artifact.

action.description: Overlay intent selected before calling topology-service. The service validates and resolves the action against the artifact graph.

operation.description: Lifecycle operation for the requested overlay or relationship output. Omitted means apply for backward compatibility.

target.description: Element, layer, or natural-language target hints. Omit only for global clear/show operations.

selector.description: Optional typed, catalog-backed selector. When present, topology-service validates and executes this selector before falling back to text or explicit target hints.

overlaySignal.description: Optional catalog-backed metric/state overlay intent. Required when action=overlay; omitted for Phase 2 highlight/focus/hide/show/inspect/drilldown operations.

relationship.description: Optional callable relationship intent. Required when action=relationship; topology-service validates relationship id, source, qualifiers, and render mode against scoped relationship availability.

options.description: Action-specific compile options that do not need separate top-level schemas.

hops.description: Neighbor expansion depth for focus or drilldown-style requests.

clearKinds.description: Layer kinds to clear when action=clear.

overlayMode.description: How a ready patch should relate to existing overlay layers.

includeInspectSummary.description: Whether inspect-style responses should include concise matched-element details in the response summary.

context.description: Non-visible request correlation and UI artifact or workbench context. This is metadata supplied by agent runtime/tool code, not prompt text for the network chatbot.

overlayRevision.description: Topology artifact overlay revision observed by the caller when compiling an artifact-mode follow-up. Used with artifactId to guard stale target/result-scope chaining.

sessionId.description: Visibility session id when compiling a topology workbench proposal.

sessionRevision.description: Session revision observed by the caller when compilation is requested.

messageId.description: User message id that triggered the follow-up.

desiredLayerIdPrefix.description: Optional stable prefix for deterministic layer ids created by the compiler.

selectedNodeIds.description: Currently selected topology node ids, when present in incoming chat context.

selectedEdgeIds.description: Currently selected topology edge ids, when present in incoming chat context.

activeLayerIds.description: Overlay layer ids currently active on the artifact surface.
